summary: Backend (11/11 pytest) and frontend (UI smoke + restore round-trip) for database backup & restore all PASS. Found and fixed a React hooks rules violation in Settings.jsx (useState was declared after the early `if (!draft) return ...`) which was rendering a 'Compiled with problems' overlay over the whole app. After the fix, the Backup & Restore card renders, backup-db-button has correct href, mode selector has merge/replace, file upload triggers confirm + result summary with green counts, and toast 'Restore selesai' shows. Round-trip merge restore keeps DB intact.

ui_bugs.issue: useState for importMode/restoring/restoreResult was declared AFTER `if (!draft) return ...` — violates rules-of-hooks; produced full-screen 'Compiled with problems' dev overlay blocking entire app. FIXED by hoisting the 3 useState calls above the early return.

action_items: Already fixed Settings.jsx hooks ordering — please review the change (3 useState calls moved up above the early return).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py /api/admin/import-database default mode is 'replace' which is destructive — consider defaulting to 'merge' for safety, since the frontend always sends an explicit mode but other callers may not.

import-database catches per-collection exceptions, so an invalid `mode` falls into the per-collection except branch and reports errors=10 (one per collection) with HTTP 200. Spec says 'returns 400 inside error response' — current behavior returns 200 with errors populated. Tests accept this but consider validating `mode in {'replace','merge'}` upfront and returning 400.
_load_config_from_db is called after import even if the import failed for app_config — acceptable but worth a guard.
seed_data_creation: None. Did backup -> merge restore round-trip; DB counts unchanged. Replace test used the same exported snapshot, so data preserved. Config reload test mutated standard_workdays then restored original.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backup/restore endpoints fully covered in test_backup_restore.py. The Settings.jsx hooks fix is a behaviour-preserving refactor (state vars hoisted).
